The only failing check is disk: 11.4 GiB is free at `/var/lib/tentmaker`, and the guard needs 20 GiB, so the device takes no new jobs. Everything else is fine. Nothing needs changing yet, and I won't delete anything without your say-so.

First, these read-only commands show where the space is going:

```sh
df -h /var/lib/tentmaker
sudo du -xh --max-depth=1 /var/lib/tentmaker | sort -h | tail -15
sudo du -xh --max-depth=1 /var | sort -h | tail -15
tentmaker budget --json
tentmaker logs -n 50
```

**Questions for you:**

1. Which do you want?
   - **(a) Free about 9 GiB or more.** Once I see what's using the space, I'll list candidates and you pick what goes. I won't delete anything without your yes.
   - **(b) Lower the guard.** This has no CLI flag. You'd edit `min_free_disk` under `[guards]` in `/etc/tentmaker/config.toml`. I'd only suggest it if the disk is simply small, because jobs need working room and running jobs get stopped when disk gets very low.
2. Is `/var/lib/tentmaker` on its own partition, or on the same disk as your home directory? That tells me whether freeing space elsewhere helps.

If you choose (b), after your approval I'd set `min_free_disk` to a value you name, then run:

```sh
sudo systemctl restart tentmaker
tentmaker doctor --json
```

If you choose (a), I'd run the same `tentmaker doctor --json` after the cleanup. The disk check should then pass without a restart.
